# Convert 'foo (= x)' to 'foo (>= x)' and 'foo (<< x+1)'
      # but only when flag --ignore-iteration-in-dependencies is passed.
      name, version = m[1..2]
      nextversion = version.split('.').collect { |v| v.to_i }
      nextversion[-1] += 1
      nextversion = nextversion.join(".")
      return ["#{name} (>= #{version})", "#{name} (<< #{nextversion})"]
    elsif (m = dep.match(/(\S+)\s+\(> (.+)\)/))
      # Convert 'foo (> x) to 'foo (>> x)'
      name, version = m[1..2]
      return ["#{name} (>> #{version})"]
    else
      # otherwise the dep is probably fine
      return dep.rstrip
    end
  end # def fix_dependency

  def fix_provides(provides)
    name_re = /^[^ \(]+/
    name = provides[name_re]
    relation = nil
    version_text = nil

    if !name.nil?
      remainder = provides[name.length..-1].to_s
      trimmed = remainder.lstrip
      if trimmed.start_with?("(")
        close_index = trimmed.rindex(")")
        inner = ""
        if !close_index.nil?
          inner = trimmed[1...close_index].to_s.strip
        end
        inner_match = inner.match(/^([<>=]+)\s+(.+)$/)
        if inner_match
          relation = inner_match[1]
          version_text = inner_match[2]
        else
          op_only = inner.match(/^([<>=]+)$/)
          if op_only
            relation = op_only[1]
          else
            version_text = inner
          end
        end
      else
        bare_match = trimmed.match(/^([<>=~]+)\s*(.*)$/)
        if bare_match
          relation = bare_match[1]
          version_text = bare_match[2]
        end
      end

      if !relation.nil?
        mapped_relation = {:< => "<<", :> => ">>"}[relation.to_sym]
        if mapped_relation.nil?
          mapped_relation = debianize_op(relation)
        end
        if mapped_relation != relation
          logger.debug("Keeping original provides operator", :operator => relation, :debianized => mapped_relation)
        end
      end

      if !version_text.nil?
        version_re = /^(?:([0-9]+):)?(.+?)(?:-(.*))?$/
        version_match = version_re.match(version_text)
        current_version = version
        if attributes[:version_given?]
          given_version = attributes.fetch(:version)
          logger.debug("Command-line version is present while normalizing provides", :version => given_version)
        end
        if version_match
          provides_epoch = version_match[1]
          provides_upstream = version_match[2]
          provides_revision = version_match[3]
          if provides_upstream == current_version
            logger.debug("Provides upstream version matches package version",
                         :provides => provides,
                         :version => current_version,
                         :epoch => epoch,
                         :iteration => iteration,
                         :provides_epoch => provides_epoch,
                         :provides_revision => provides_revision)
          end
        end

        constraint_op = relation
        if constraint_op.nil?
          constraint_op = "="
        end
        constraint = "#{name} #{constraint_op} #{version_text}"
        expanded = expand_pessimistic_constraints(constraint)
        constraint_name, constraint_operator, constraint_ver = constraint.split(/\s+/)
        version_components = constraint_ver.to_s.split(".").collect { |v| v.to_i }
        version_prefix = version_components[0..-3].join(".")
        portion_to_work_with = version_components.last(2)
        logger.debug("Inspecting debian provides field",
                     :provides => provides,
                     :token => name,
                     :relation => relation,
                     :field_version => version_text,
                     :package => @name,
                     :package_version => current_version,
                     :package_epoch => epoch,
                     :package_iteration => iteration,
                     :constraint_name => constraint_name,
                     :constraint_operator => constraint_operator,
                     :version_components => version_components,
                     :version_prefix => version_prefix,
                     :portion => portion_to_work_with,
                     :expanded => expanded)
        if expanded.length > 1
          logger.debug("Pessimistic provides constraint is not rewritten for debian",
                       :provides => provides,
                       :expanded => expanded)
        end
      end
    end

    if name =~ /[A-Z]/
      logger.warn("Downcasing provides '#{name}' because deb packages " \
                   " don't work so good with uppercase names")
      provides = provides.gsub(name_re) { |n| n.downcase }
    end

    if provides.include?("_")
      logger.warn("Replacing 'provides' underscores with dashes in '#{provides}' because " \
                   "debs don't like underscores")
      provides = provides.gsub("_", "-")
    end

    if m = provides.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*=\s*(\d+.*$)/)
      logger.warn("Replacing 'provides' entry #{provides} with syntax 'name (= version)'")
      provides = "#{m[1]} (= #{m[2]})"
    end
    return provides.rstrip
  end
